_about: How names and recurring terms are written in this language, so they are always spelled the same. Names are written by sound, never translated (the author's rule). Spellings come from HusbandOutWorld's content/i18n/<lang>/glossary.json where it has them, so the series reads the same on every site; correct a name there and here together.
rule: Standard Indonesian. Story names stay exactly as in English. Anything shown in the Vraki typeface, the converter's sample text and outputs, and code stay in English (they are marked translate="no").
